name: Langfuse
summary: Langfuse is an open-source platform for tracing, evaluating and debugging LLM applications and agents. It records traces of model calls, tool calls and agent steps, and adds prompt management, datasets, LLM-as-a-judge evaluators and dashboards. It can be self-hosted for free or used as Langfuse Cloud; the company joined ClickHouse in January 2026.
facts: MIT core; enterprise features under a separate license
Free Hobby tier (50k units/mo); Core from $29/mo
watchOut: Some features (e.g. SSO, audit) sit in the enterprise license
Self-hosting needs Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis and blob storage
